maria (PM): Short design review: rollouts timeline + canary/A-B controls. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/rollouts-redo
kevin (Design): Proposal: collapsed timeline nodes with "show changes" chevron, mini-KPIs on expand, scrubber to pin details. Will add icons for non-color cues.
alex (Frontend): Agree. Implement chips for presets (5/10/25/50) + numeric input. Inline rollback button should open modal; prod requires confirm phrase.
jamie (Eng-Platform): API plan: GET /rollouts/:id/history?range= and POST /rollouts/:id/rollback accepting {reason,confirm}. History nodes include changes_summary, metrics_snapshot (capped points), auto_rollback_policy. ETA: tomorrow deploy.
olivia (Accessibility): Must add ARIA labels, keyboard-accessible slider/stepper, 44px hit targets, aria-live updates for details panel. Provide text equivalents for badges like "Canary 5 percent running".
sam (SRE): Add auto-fallback policy UI: show thresholds and editable rules. Timeline entries must surface who triggered and a short note.
kevin (Design): Copy tweaks: "Launch canary (recommended: 5%)"; badge text "Canary 05%"; rollback CTA "Rollback to vX.Y (opens modal)". Dark mode tokens updated.
maria (PM): Decisions: visible canary CTA -> opens modal; timeline collapsed by default; modal for prod rollback; A/B presets + numeric input; mini-KPIs; a11y items as Olivia listed; Jamie to expose APIs.
design-bot: Design review created for thread 1748209999.
alex (Frontend): I'll branch feat/rollouts-timeline and stub APIs. Ping when staging preview is up.
jamie (Eng-Platform): Will post changelog when endpoints are live.
olivia (Accessibility): Will run quick screen reader pass on staging.
maria (PM): Thanks — we'll reconvene if blockers. Please react with :+1: or :eyes: after reviewing Figma.
__comment: Single Slack thread in one string, metadata fields flat and compliant with agents.md
